summary: Markets are decisively risk-off: equities and crypto sold off sharply, while Brent crude remained elevated on geopolitical supply concerns. Bitcoin fell below $59,000, gold weakened to a 14-month low, and available social sentiment showed mostly neutral-to-bearish positioning; the search results did not verify same-day posts from the specifically named traders.
